title: Completing and submitting the questionnaire
purpose: Close the questionnaire. Remind non-Swiss employees and employees living abroad to bring their permit, and on submission record only the answers to questions that still apply.

stories.title: Remind employees to bring their permit on the first working day
stories.i_want: every non-Swiss employee and every employee living abroad to be reminded at the end of the questionnaire to bring their permit on the first working day
stories.so_that: fewer new employees forget their permit on day one (today about half of them do), without Lonio collecting any extra data
stories.priority_reason: HR states a recurring pain ("Half of them forget") but it does not block any registration; the reminder collects no data and is a convenience for HR.

acceptance_criteria.title: Who gets the permit reminder
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee has reached the end of the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee lives abroad (home address country is not Switzerland), or lives in Switzerland and is not Swiss
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is reminded to bring their permit on the first working day; an employee living in Switzerland who holds Swiss citizenship (even with another nationality) gets no reminder

examples.name: Employee living in Germany (nationality not asked)

acceptance_criteria.title: The reminder collects no data
acceptance_criteria.given: the permit reminder is shown to an employee
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee does not have to answer, confirm or upload anything in response to the reminder; the permit is brought to HR in person on the first working day, outside Lonio

acceptance_criteria.title: HR provides the wording
acceptance_criteria.then: the reminder uses the wording HR provides; the purpose stays the same: to remind the employee to bring their permit on the first working day

stories.title: Discard answers that no longer apply on submission
stories.i_want: to go back and change earlier answers without losing input, while only the answers to questions that still apply to me are recorded when I submit
stories.so_that: no party ends up holding personal data about me that it does not need (data minimisation), and I don't have to retype answers while correcting myself
stories.priority_reason: Data minimisation is a core requirement of the feature (G-01): keeping answers no party needs means holding personal data Lonio must not have.

acceptance_criteria.title: Answers are kept while the employee moves back and forth
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee has answered later questions and then changes an earlier answer so that those questions no longer apply
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee is still filling in the questionnaire and changes the earlier answer back
acceptance_criteria.then: the earlier answers to the later questions can still be there, so the employee does not lose input

acceptance_criteria.title: Only applicable answers are recorded on submission
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee has answered questions that no longer apply after changing an earlier answer
acceptance_criteria.then: the answers to questions that no longer apply are discarded and not recorded for HR or any receiving party; only answers to questions that apply to the final answers are recorded

examples.name: Employee first said Married, then changed to Single
Employee first entered a Swiss address, then changed to Germany
Employee first entered another nationality, then changed to Switzerland
